body.text: In games before Prism Scale evolution, Feebas evolves into Milotic by raising its Beauty condition to 170 and then leveling up. See the Evolving Feebas into Milotic via Beauty guide for Dry berries, Pokeblocks, Poffins, nature preferences, and reset planning.

body.text: Feebas has different catching methods depending on the game, including Route 119 tile hunting, Mt. Coronet BF1 fishing, and later-generation shortcuts. Start with the Catching Feebas: Every Generation guide hub for links to each detailed guide.
